latestVersion.changelog:
- Designated admet-pkpd/scripts/sciminer_registry.py as the authoritative source for all provider_name, tool_name, allowed parameters, and file_params.
- Updated instructions: agents must construct invocation payloads strictly using the registry (never from memory or OpenAPI), and should filter user parameters against the registry before every API call.
- Added detailed invocation example and usage pattern for build_payload_from_registry from the registry.
- Clarified file upload field requirements and mapping per tool as recorded in the registry.
- Specified error handling and user messaging if user input parameters do not match the registry for a selected tool.
